recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-36828; any future gateway representation changes should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or through a new OO/FMG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-36828 was a Published/Persuasive R5 OO request to replace the Device.link backbone with Device.gateway 0..* CodeableReference(Device), described as the linked device acting as a communication/data collector, translator, or controller for the current device.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged core commit 3932ce4be6 replaced Device.link with Device.gateway in source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml, changed the type from BackboneElement to CodeableReference(Device), and removed the link.relation/link.relatedDevice backbone. FHIR-37614 later refined the Device.gateway definition and comment before R5 publication.
additional_context: Device is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current R6 source has no active Device.link or Device.gateway after XML comments are stripped; fhir.ini records Device.gateway as an R5-to-R6 removal. Later final issues FHIR-32565, FHIR-48923, and FHIR-47326 approved moving Device.gateway out of core and replacing it with the Extension Pack device-gateway extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing Device.gateway into core would reverse later R6 decisions, and Extension Pack edits are outside this FHIR-core branch.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the gateway relation-code definition used by the R5 Device.link/gateway work.
Refined Device.gateway wording and added guidance distinguishing Observation.gatewayDevice use cases.
Approved moving Device.gateway and other less-common Device elements out of core into extensions for R6.
Core approval/application trail for removing Device.endpoint and Device.gateway from Device and relying on extensions.
Extension Pack issue creating device-gateway as the replacement for removed Device.gateway.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 request to replace the Device.link backbone with Device.gateway 0..* CodeableReference(Device).
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed issue request and final OO decision that mattered for R5.

evidence_items.summary: The Jira-tagged implementation replaced Device.link with Device.gateway and changed it to CodeableReference(Device).
evidence_items.learned: The seed was applied in core source before later R6 changes.

evidence_items.summary: Current Device source has Device.gateway only in a commented-out removal block, and fhir.ini records Device.gateway as removed between R5 and R6.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope core Device definition has no active Device.link or Device.gateway element.

evidence_items.summary: OO minutes record the FHIR-37614 8-0-0 motion to refine Device.gateway text in conjunction with FHIR-36828.
evidence_items.learned: The later R5 decision clarifies, rather than reverses, the seed application.

evidence_items.summary: Later final decisions moved Device.gateway and related Device communication elements out of core into extensions.
evidence_items.learned: The missing active Device.gateway in current core source is intentional later R6 scope, not an un-applied FHIR-36828 defect.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack contains a device-gateway extension with CodeableReference(Device) value and Device/Observation contexts.
evidence_items.learned: The current gateway representation belongs to the Extension Pack rather than the core FHIR checkout.

evidence_items.summary: No active link/gateway element remained after stripping XML comments; Zulip had no matching discussion, and Confluence refs pointed to known OO/DEV minutes.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered source or community evidence contradicts the no-change conclusion.
